description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::container internal unordered_map constructors, including various initialization scenarios, copy/move semantics, and allocator behaviors.

classes.name: ConstructorTest
classes.description: A templated test fixture class for testing unordered_map constructors.

methods.name: NoArgs
methods.description: Tests default constructor and checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: BucketCount
methods.description: Tests constructor with bucket count parameter.

methods.name: BucketCountHash
methods.description: Tests constructor with bucket count and hasher.

methods.name: BucketCountHashEqual
methods.description: Tests constructor with bucket count, hasher, and key_equal.

methods.name: BucketCountHashEqualAlloc
methods.description: Tests constructor with bucket count, hasher, key_equal, and allocator.

methods.name: BucketCountAlloc
methods.description: Tests constructor with bucket count and allocator, conditioned on C++14/17 support.

methods.name: InputIteratorBucketHashEqualAlloc

methods.description: Tests constructor with input iterators, bucket count, hasher, and allocator.

methods.description: Tests constructor with initializer list, bucket count, and allocator.

methods.name: InitializerListBucketHashAlloc
